description: This file defines a class and multiple functions related to bank reconciliation, including fetching transactions, updating transactions, creating journal and payment entries, and matching vouchers within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: BankReconciliationTool
classes.description: A Document class representing the bank reconciliation tool in ERPNext.

methods.name: get_bank_transactions
methods.description: Fetches bank transactions for a specified bank account within optional date range.

methods.name: get_account_balance
methods.description: Calculates the account balance till a specified date, considering system entries and reflected amounts.

methods.name: update_bank_transaction
methods.description: Updates details of a bank transaction with new reference number, party type, and party.

methods.name: create_journal_entry_bts
methods.description: Creates and optionally submits a journal entry based on a bank transaction.

methods.name: create_payment_entry_bts
methods.description: Creates and optionally submits a payment entry based on a bank transaction.

methods.name: reconcile_vouchers
methods.description: Reconciles vouchers with a bank transaction, updating allocations and clearances.

methods.name: get_linked_payments
methods.description: Retrieves all matching payments linked to a specific bank transaction.
